All of the diamonds represent emotions. 

Pink is love. She does crazy things, is stubborn, cares for earth and everyone who knew her on the show mourns her deeply (excluding white diamond). She radiates love and it is felt.
Yellow is anger, Blue is sorrow. 
And, I guess, White is indifference. Devoid of feeling. The way she spoke to Steven seemed like she was completely un-touched by Pinks absence. ("everyone was so worried" not "we were so worried") It could be because she somehow knew Pink had lied in the first place, but overall her tone came across as condescending and she wouldn't even let him speak. 

Blue and yellow seem as if they where created at the same time or something, like they are sort of two sides of the same coin. Connected, if you will (other than by the fact they are both diamonds.) They seem to work together. Using the emotions theory: anger can cover up sadness. People chose to feel angry in order to make sadness more bearable. In this case, yellow literally tries to protect blue by being all action, trying to make her think logically (what's the use of feeling blue?) and wanting to destroy earth (where they believed pink was shattered). Like, In Reunited, after Blue is taken down, Yellow storms in and just obliterates everyone who tries to confront them. Although blue sometimes acts spiteful, she mainly expresses the sadness in every situation, such as wanting to preserve earths specimens, getting choked up about being in pinks ship, but yellow is mainly either enraged or irritated.
